{{Quote|I'm here because you're making secret deliveries from Bugtown to Moff Tyrak, Imperial Commander of the Sixty-third Armored Infantry Division.|[[Akaavi Spar]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sixty-third Armored Infantry Division''' was a division within the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the unit was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] under the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]].
